environment.name: ALIYUN_REFRESH_TOKEN
environment.howToGet: Sign in to the Aliyun Drive web application and copy the refresh_token value from its authenticated browser storage. Never share it.
environment.format: One non-empty refresh token per line; blank lines are ignored.

environment.name: ALIYUN_DRIVE_DRY_RUN
environment.howToGet: Set to 1 to simulate every account without network access, delay, check-in, or credential persistence.
environment.format: Boolean: 1, true, yes, or on enables it.

environment.name: ALIYUN_MAX_DELAY_SECONDS
environment.howToGet: Optional maximum random delay before a live run; defaults to 0.

environment.name: ALIYUN_PERSIST_ROTATED_TOKENS
environment.howToGet: Explicitly set to 1 only if rotated refresh tokens should be written through the file adapter; disabled by default.
environment.format: Boolean: 1, true, yes, or on enables it.

environment.name: ALIYUN_TOKEN_OUTPUT_FILE
environment.howToGet: Choose an existing-directory absolute path for the opt-in token file. It is required only when persistence is enabled.
environment.format: Absolute filesystem path; the file is atomically replaced with mode 0600 and contains one token per line.

environment.name: QINGLONG_NOTIFY
environment.howToGet: 无需获取；默认通过青龙 notify.py 推送脱敏任务总结，设为 0 可关闭。

environment.name: QINGLONG_NOTIFY_DIR
environment.howToGet: 仅当 notify.py 不在青龙标准路径时，填写其所在目录。

multiAccount.rule: ALIYUN_REFRESH_TOKEN uses one non-empty account per line; blank lines are ignored and every account is processed independently.

features: Daily Aliyun Drive membership check-in with explicit response validation
Independent newline-delimited multi-account processing with aggregate exit status
Network-free deterministic dry-run simulation
Refresh-token rotation detection with optional secure file persistence
sideEffects: Performs an Aliyun Drive membership check-in for each account during live runs
Refreshes each account access token and may rotate its refresh token during live runs
When explicitly enabled, atomically writes current refresh tokens to the configured local file

environment.name: BAIDUWANGPAN_DELAY_MAX
